entries.requiredEvidence: Approved versioned runbook bound to release source commit, build run, artifact digest, platform target, and operation role.
entries.plannedAction: External release/operations owner must approve exact platform target and execution role before any platform operation.

entries.requiredEvidence: Approved rollback target, rollback validation, trigger policy, escalation path, and independent rollback/drill authorization.
entries.plannedAction: External approval must bind rollback target release, artifact digest, provenance, and deployability.

entries.requiredEvidence: Approved thresholds, measurement windows, query sources, parity datasets, pass/abort/rollback rules, and expiry.
entries.plannedAction: Bind approved SLI/parity thresholds from an authoritative SLO/baseline/approval source.

entries.requiredEvidence: Validator test pass and production-input validator output showing PASS only when all mandatory approvals and platform receipts are valid.
entries.plannedAction: Run validator against current real input and preserve the blocked output.

entries.requiredEvidence: Approval record with baseline ID, data version, metrics source, observation period, baseline digest, and scope.
entries.plannedAction: Obtain a verifiable approval record from the proper release governance authority.

entries.requiredEvidence: Approval record binding rollback release/version, artifact URI, digest, provenance, compatibility, and deployability.
entries.plannedAction: Obtain a verifiable rollback target approval from the proper release governance authority.

entries.requiredEvidence: Approval record binding account, region, environment, service, namespace, traffic scope, duration, allowed operations, and abort limits.
entries.plannedAction: Obtain a verifiable canary scope approval before any verification drill.

entries.requiredEvidence: Unexpired independent authorization that permits rollback execution in the approved scope.
entries.plannedAction: Obtain explicit rollback authorization; do not infer it from runbook completion.

entries.requiredEvidence: Unexpired independent authorization for a rollback drill in the approved non-production scope.
entries.plannedAction: Obtain explicit rollback drill authorization before any drill.

entries.requirement: Deploy, canary, and rollback platform receipts
entries.requiredEvidence: Provider/platform-generated operation IDs bound to current artifact digest, approved environment, actor principal, timestamps, final status, and audit metadata.
entries.plannedAction: Run only after all approvals, runbooks, criteria, caller identity, and scope checks pass.
